name: Simple AI
summary: Simple AI is a Beijing company developing general-purpose embodied robots for service environments. It combines its own mobile manipulation hardware with models, task planning and data collection systems. The company uses hotel and other household-like commercial settings as an initial deployment environment, with the longer-term aim of household robotics. Its Xiaopu Simbot has been publicly demonstrated performing service and household-style tasks at the 2026 World Robot Conference.
